boundary.boundary_rule: Exact geometry intersects published Seoul polygon. District crossing can count in multiple districts.

classification_note: Primary counts use exact 'incline'. Bare numeric tags and degree tags are reported separately. Up/down have no magnitude. No tag is unknown, never promoted to zero. Position, tag and status retain OSM registration provenance only.

source_metadata.coverage_limit: Visible registration in a single OSM release. Geometry is not field surveying, and registered ways/areas may include closed, private, stairs or grade-separated passages.
source_metadata.allowed_geometry_differences: OSM IDs are counted once per layer, layers can overlap, tags preserved. No snapped connection, entrance point, or new slope.
source_metadata.scope_selection: Intersects preserved 26 administrative geometries. Cross-boundary objects may occur in multiple district counts. Source geometries stay whole.

metadata.scope: Seoul-covering rectangular OSM subset, not an administrative completeness claim
metadata.notice: OSM registration reference routing; curb/width/surface grade/entrances/current access unverified. Bridges/tunnels/indoor/blocked nodes withheld; no fabricated links.
metadata.registered_incline_role: OSM tag constraints only, not measured surface grades

active_city_walk.note: Existing city-walk routing asset covers a broader rectangular OSM extract. Numeric grades are adopted registration constraints, not physical measurements.
